notes: level 'requirement' = the 12 principal requirements; 'sub' = x.y sub-requirement groups; 'req' = selected x.y.z requirements with a cadence the standard itself prescribes (daily log review 10.4.1, weekly FIM 11.5.2, quarterly scans 11.3.1/11.3.2, semiannual NSC review 1.2.7 and access review 7.2.4, annual pentest 11.4.2/11.4.3, annual training 12.6.3 and risk analyses 12.3.1). For 'requirement' and 'sub' rows defaultFrequency is Darknode's evidence cadence suggestion. Appendix A1 (multi-tenant providers), A2 (SSL/early TLS on POS POI) and A3 (designated entities) are not included.

data.title: Install and maintain network security controls
Processes and mechanisms for network security controls defined and understood
Network security controls configured and maintained
NSC configurations reviewed at least once every six months
evidenceHints: Dated rule-set review with findings and sign-off

data.title: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment restricted
Connections between trusted and untrusted networks controlled
Risks from devices connecting to both untrusted networks and the CDE mitigated
evidenceHints: Host firewall or equivalent configuration on portable devices

data.title: Apply secure configurations to all system components
Processes and mechanisms for secure configurations defined and understood
System components configured and managed securely
Wireless environments configured and managed securely
Protect stored account data
Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data defined and understood
Storage of account data kept to a minimum
Account data retention minimised with a process run at least every three months to delete data beyond retention
Sensitive authentication data not stored after authorisation
Access to displays of full PAN and ability to copy PAN restricted
evidenceHints: Copy or relocate controls on remote access

data.title: Primary account number secured wherever it is stored
Cryptographic keys protecting stored account data secured
Key management processes and procedures defined and implemented
evidenceHints: Key generation, distribution, rotation and retirement records

data.title: Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks
Processes and mechanisms for protecting transmitted cardholder data defined and understood
PAN protected with strong cryptography during transmission
evidenceHints: Inventory of trusted keys and certificates

data.title: Protect all systems and networks from malicious software
Processes and mechanisms for malware protection defined and understood
Malicious software prevented, or detected and addressed
Anti-malware mechanisms and processes active, maintained and monitored
Anti-phishing mechanisms protect users against phishing attacks
Develop and maintain secure systems and software
Processes and mechanisms for secure systems and software defined and understood
Bespoke and custom software developed securely
Security vulnerabilities identified and addressed
Critical or high-security patches installed within one month of release
evidenceHints: Patch deployment reports with dates against release dates

data.title: Public-facing web applications protected against attacks
evidenceHints: WAF or automated technical solution configuration
Script inventory and authorisation for payment pages

data.title: Changes to all system components managed securely
evidenceHints: Change records with approval, impact and back-out
Live PAN not used in test

data.title: Restrict access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know
Processes and mechanisms for restricting access defined and understood
Access to system components and data appropriately defined and assigned
All user accounts and access privileges reviewed at least once every six months
evidenceHints: Dated access review with remediation sign-off

data.title: Access managed via access control systems
Identify users and authenticate access to system components
Processes and mechanisms for identification and authentication defined and understood
User identification and related accounts strictly managed
Strong authentication for users and administrators established and managed
Passwords changed at least every 90 days or dynamic risk analysis applied, where passwords are the only factor
Multi-factor authentication implemented to secure access into the CDE
MFA systems configured to prevent misuse
Application and system accounts and their authentication factors strictly managed
Restrict physical access to cardholder data
Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access defined and understood
Physical access controls manage entry into facilities and systems containing cardholder data
Physical access for personnel and visitors authorised and managed
Media with cardholder data securely stored, accessed, distributed and destroyed
Inventories of electronic media with cardholder data conducted at least once every 12 months
Point-of-interaction devices protected from tampering and substitution
Log and monitor all access to system components and cardholder data
Processes and mechanisms for logging and monitoring defined and understood
Audit logs implemented to support detection of anomalies and forensic analysis
Audit logs protected from destruction and unauthorised modification
Audit logs reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity
evidenceHints: Daily review records or automated alerting evidence

data.title: Security event logs, CDE component logs, critical system logs and NSC logs reviewed at least once daily
evidenceHints: Daily review sign-off or alert triage records

data.title: Audit log history retained and available for analysis
Time-synchronisation mechanisms support consistent time settings
Failures of critical security control systems detected, reported and responded to promptly
Test security of systems and networks regularly
Processes and mechanisms for regular security testing defined and understood
Wireless access points identified and monitored, unauthorised ones addressed
Authorised and unauthorised wireless access points managed at least once every three months
External and internal vulnerabilities regularly identified, prioritised and addressed
Internal vulnerability scans performed at least once every three months with rescans until high-risk and critical issues resolved
evidenceHints: Four passing quarterly internal scan reports

data.title: External vulnerability scans by an Approved Scanning Vendor at least once every three months
evidenceHints: Four passing quarterly ASV scan reports

data.title: External and internal penetration testing regularly performed and findings corrected
Internal penetration test at least once every 12 months and after significant changes
External penetration test at least once every 12 months and after significant changes
Segmentation controls tested by penetration test at least once every 12 months (every six months for service providers under 11.4.6)
Network intrusions and unexpected file changes detected and responded to
evidenceHints: IDS or IPS configuration and alerts

data.title: Change-detection mechanism alerts on unauthorised modification of critical files; comparisons at least once weekly
evidenceHints: FIM configuration and weekly comparison evidence

data.title: Unauthorised changes on payment pages detected and responded to
evidenceHints: Payment page change-and-tamper detection evaluation records (at least every seven days or per targeted risk analysis)

data.title: Support information security with organisational policies and programs
Comprehensive information security policy established and maintained
Information security policy reviewed at least once every 12 months and updated as needed
Acceptable use policies for end-user technologies defined and implemented
Risks to the cardholder data environment formally identified, evaluated and managed
Targeted risk analyses performed and reviewed at least once every 12 months for each flexible-frequency requirement
evidenceHints: Documented targeted risk analyses with review dates

data.title: Hardware and software technologies in use reviewed at least once every 12 months
evidenceHints: Technology review records including end-of-life analysis

data.title: PCI DSS compliance managed
evidenceHints: Service provider quarterly reviews of personnel performing security tasks

data.title: Service providers: reviews at least once every three months confirming personnel perform required tasks
evidenceHints: Dated quarterly review records and sign-off

data.title: PCI DSS scope documented and validated
evidenceHints: Scope confirmation (annual; every six months for service providers)

data.title: PCI DSS scope documented and confirmed at least once every 12 months and upon significant change
Security awareness education is an ongoing activity
Security awareness program reviewed at least once every 12 months
Personnel receive security awareness training upon hire and at least once every 12 months
Personnel screened to reduce risks from insider threats
evidenceHints: Background check records for CDE-access roles

data.title: Risk to information assets associated with third-party service providers managed
TPSP PCI DSS compliance status monitored at least once every 12 months
Third-party service providers support their customers' PCI DSS compliance
Suspected and confirmed security incidents responded to immediately
Incident response plan reviewed and tested at least once every 12 months
evidenceHints: Dated plan review and exercise report
